# CEO Owl

> Private English grammar checking. The web editor runs the Harper engine on your own device, so checked text never leaves the browser. AI clients connect to the same checker over a signed-in MCP connection. English only. Submitted text is processed in memory and never stored or logged.

## MCP server

- Endpoint: https://ceoowl.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP)
- Authentication: OAuth (Supabase) — sign in once, then connect. See https://ceoowl.com/docs for client configuration.
- Tool: `check_grammar` — finds grammar, spelling, punctuation and style problems in English text. Returns findings with character offsets and suggested replacements.

Example tool call:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 2,
  "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "check_grammar",
    "arguments": {
      "text": "<your english text>",
      "language": "en",
      "include_suggestions": true,
      "include_rule_ids": true
    }
  }
}
```
